title: Enforcement Surcharge on Parking License Reinstatement
content:
Community parking rules: a Parking License with a recent violation record pays an enforcement surcharge when its suspended privileges are restored.

## Rule

When 3 or more violations of any level were recorded on the license in the 12 months before the handling date, the enforcement surcharge is $15.00; when at least one but fewer than 3 violations were recorded in those months, the enforcement surcharge is $10.00; in every other case there is no enforcement surcharge. The enforcement surcharge is added to the reinstatement fee.

"Of any level" takes in warnings, fines and tows alike.

## Surcharge by violations recorded

| Violations recorded on the license in the 12 months before the handling date | Enforcement surcharge |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | $15.00 |
| 1 or 2 | $10.00 |
| none | none |

## Illustrations (hypothetical records)

- One warning and one fine in the 12 months: 2 violations, $10.00.
- Two warnings and one tow: 3 violations, $15.00.
- One fine 13 months before the handling date and nothing since: none.
